title: Night-time headlight false-positive suppression: suntime-driven quiet hours + dispatcher gate + per-camera baseline overrides
author: jill-agent
plan_section: V2-062 supersedes V2-046 (yolo-night-false-alarm-suppression, 2026-09-15, status=active but never dispatched). V2-046 only covered NIGHT_SUPPRESS env-flag enable + OUTSIDE_FRONT_SOLAR threshold bump; that proved insufficient because (1) the 0.40 confidence floor misses the 0.5-0.69 band that vision still emits for headlights-as-cars, (2) there is no dispatcher-level quiet-hours gate so vision noise still reaches Telegram during night hours, (3) the 4 affected exterior cameras are not all addressed. V2-062 adds three layers: suntime-driven quiet hours with 30-min twilight buffer (per operator 2026-09-20 directive), a dispatcher-level Telegram gate that suppresses quiet-hours alerts, and per-camera baseline-override config for distance/ambiguity keywords. All knobs are env-tunable per operator 2026-09-20 directive. Worker preflight enforces v2-vs-refactor directory separation per operator 2026-09-20 directive.
trigger: Operator 2026-09-20 (verbatim, telegram msg): 'Step 1-3, not 4. Make sure these applications use options that can be set in the environmental file. Make sure the worker does not get confused on what directory version is being worked on. Add something that doesn't just hardcode the time of day to implement it that actually figures out when sunrise and sunset is it 30 minutes after sunset in 30 minutes before sunrise.' Operator 2026-09-20 also stated (verbatim): 'No deletions'. Operator 2026-09-19 (verbatim): 'I had a bunch of false alarms last night that made it all the way through the way we had addressed that on the version one refactor was to do a tuning to Yolo or do some kind of sensible thing to Yolo, I forget what it was'. Confirmed headlight FPs on 2026-09-19/20 overnight window: (a) eda3b858 01:20 AM OUTSIDE_FRONT_SOLAR car 0.58 -- vision LLM saw headlight glow + flare, called it 'car'; (b) 163e10ea 22:23 OUTSIDE_BACK_SOLAR cat 0.72 with 62% frame-area motion bbox -- frames deleted, highly suspected headlight illumination.
background: Root cause is multi-layer. (1) infra/gate.py default THRESHOLDS_BY_CLASS['cat']=0.60 plus default confidence thresholds lets a 0.5-0.69 false-positive band slip through on the 4 exterior cameras (CAM3=CAMC4=CAMC5=CAMC6 = OUTSIDE_FRONT_GARAGE, OUTSIDE_FRONT_POWER, OUTSIDE_FRONT_SOLAR, OUTSIDE_BACK_SOLAR). v2's infra/quick_classifier.py has the v1 NIGHT_SUPPRESS primitive (inherited dormant, MOTION_GATE_NIGHT_SUPPRESS_ENABLED=0 default) which uses suntime + brightness_ratio + confidence floor, but confidence floor 0.40 misses the 0.5-0.69 'car'/'cat' band that Qwen3-VL confidently emits on headlight glow. (2) v2 has NO dispatcher-level quiet-hours gate. Even when motion-gate suppresses the motion event, the listener still emits Telegram alerts when Qwen classifies a glowing blob as 'car' or 'cat' with conf > 0.40. (3) v2 has NO infra/time_of_day.py (refactor has it but the file is not ported). The hardcoded EDT hour assumption from any naive quiet-hours implementation would fail across seasons at farm coordinates 34.5782N, -84.9438W (Resaca, GA): civil twilight ranges from 5:48 AM (winter) to 6:38 AM (summer), sunset ranges 6:45 PM (winter) to 8:55 PM (summer). (4) v2 has NO infra/alert_overrides_baseline.py for per-camera distance-keyword demotion. The refactor proved that 'distant vehicle with light source' scene_description keywords correlate strongly with headlight FPs and are demotable via baseline override. v2's listener/daemon.py tg-send call sites (_send_tg1/_send_tg2/_send_tg3, lines ~540/586/630) have no quiet-hours check between alert generation and dispatcher.dispatch().

operator_guarantees.env_var_every_knob: Every night/quiet-hours/threshold/camera-list tunable is exposed via environment variable. NO hardcoded hour-of-day constants, NO hardcoded brightness ratios, NO hardcoded confidence floors in shipped code. Worker MUST NOT edit the .env file directly; it MUST only edit .env.example with placeholder defaults. The real .env is gitignored per US-017b.
operator_guarantees.suntime_not_hardcoded: Sunrise/sunset calculation uses python suntime library against farm latitude/longitude (configurable via FARMSURV_FARM_LAT / FARMSURV_FARM_LON env vars, default 34.5782N / -84.9438W for Resaca, GA). Twilight buffer is 30 minutes AFTER sunset and 30 minutes BEFORE sunrise per operator 2026-09-20 directive. NO 'night starts at 8pm' literal in code.
operator_guarantees.directory_guard: Worker MUST verify before each commit that its working directory is <INSTALL_DIR>/ and NOT ~/farm-surveillance-refactor/ or ~/farm-surveillance/ (v1). Preflight script bin/preflight_v2_only.sh asserts cwd is v2 root; gates the first commit. NO edits to refactor/v1 directories in any US-062x story.
operator_guarantees.no_deletions: Per operator 2026-09-20 directive 'No deletions'. ~/farm-surveillance-refactor/ is preserved untouched. ~/farm-surveillance/ (v1) is preserved untouched. v2's existing infra/quick_classifier.py NIGHT_SUPPRESS code path is preserved (only the wrapper config that flips the env flag from 0 to 1 changes).
operator_guarantees.git_maintained: Every story lands as a real commit on main BEFORE claiming done. Reviewer verifies via git log main --grep <story_id>.
operator_guarantees.code_actually_written: Every AC is a re-runnable shell command with explicit expected output. Reviewer round-2 lens: checkout work, run AC verbatim, compare actual vs expected.
operator_guarantees.no_residue: After each story lands, the file MUST contain the new code AND no commented-out old code. No 'if False:' branches keeping the old template. No backward-compat shims.
operator_guarantees.no_phantom_done: No story claims done without code-grep on local main. Branch tip is not enough. Reviewer verifies via git show main:<file>.
operator_guarantees.no_camera_changes: No Reolink camera web-UI changes. v2-side fixes only. Per V2-046 scope exclusion carried forward.
operator_guarantees.no_push: Per V2-046 scope exclusion carried forward. Operator reviews and pushes.
operator_guarantees.no_new_skills: Per V2-046 scope exclusion carried forward. Use existing skill set.
operator_guarantees.no_daemon_restart: Operator restarts the daemon manually post-merge to pick up the new .env values. Per V2-046 carry forward.

shipping_definition: (a) infra/time_of_day.py exports is_night_at_edt(timestamp) and get_night_window() using suntime against FARMSURV_FARM_LAT / FARMSURV_FARM_LON with FARMSURV_NIGHT_TWILIGHT_BUFFER_MIN=30 default. (b) infra/quiet_hours.py exports in_quiet_hours(timestamp, camera_name) that returns True only when is_night_at_edt(timestamp) is True AND camera_name is in FARMSURV_QUIET_HOURS_CAMERAS env. (c) listener/daemon.py calls in_quiet_hours() before each tg-send call site (_send_tg1/_send_tg2/_send_tg3) and short-circuits with a structured log line. (d) infra/alert_overrides_baseline.py exports _apply_distant_vehicle_baseline_override(alert, vision_result, camera_name, timestamp) that demotes L1 to L0 when off-hours + camera in baseline override config + vision sees vehicle + scene_description has distance/ambiguity keyword + no person present. (e) config/alert_overrides.json carries the baseline override config with FARMSURV_BASELINE_OVERRIDE_CAMERAS env-var-driven camera list. (f) .env.example documents every new env var with placeholder + comment. (g) bin/preflight_v2_only.sh asserts cwd is v2 root. (h) Working tree clean. (i) No camera-side changes. (j) No deletions to refactor or v1.

Do NOT touch the daemon plist or restart the daemon. Operator restarts manually after merge.

Do NOT modify any existing test files that don't need changes. If a test breaks because it expected hardcoded hours, delete the assertion per V2-046 'DELETE old tests not skip them' precedent, do not skip.
design_principles: All three layers of defense: (1) motion-gate NIGHT_SUPPRESS already in quick_classifier.py (just enable via env), (2) dispatcher quiet-hours gate (NEW in v2.062), (3) baseline override for distance-keyword demotion (NEW in v2.062). Each layer independently suppresses the FP. Belt + suspenders + safety pin.

Sunrise/sunset calculation MUST use python suntime. NO hardcoded hours like '8 PM to 6 AM'. The farm is in EDT (UTC-4) with no DST auto-switch inside suntime (operator uses fixed UTC-4). Twilight window = sunset + 30 min ... sunrise - 30 min per operator directive.

Worker preflight: bin/preflight_v2_only.sh asserts cwd basename is 'farm-surveillance-v2' (NOT 'farm-surveillance-refactor' or 'farm-surveillance'). Fails the pre-commit hook if cwd is wrong. The script is committed to main once (US-062a).

Env-tunable knobs (with defaults): FARMSURV_FARM_LAT=34.5782, FARMSURV_FARM_LON=-84.9438, FARMSURV_NIGHT_TWILIGHT_BUFFER_MIN=30, FARMSURV_QUIET_HOURS_ENABLED=1 (kill switch), FARMSURV_QUIET_HOURS_CAMERAS='OUTSIDE_FRONT_SOLAR,OUTSIDE_BACK_SOLAR,OUTSIDE_FRONT_POWER,OUTSIDE_FRONT_GARAGE', FARMSURV_BASELINE_OVERRIDE_ENABLED=1, FARMSURV_BASELINE_OVERRIDE_CAMERAS='OUTSIDE_FRONT_SOLAR,OUTSIDE_BACK_SOLAR', FARMSURV_DISTANT_KEYWORDS='faint,indistinct,distant,reflection,light source,moving lights,far away,barely visible,glare,headlight', MOTION_GATE_NIGHT_SUPPRESS_ENABLED=1 (already-existing env var, just flip from 0 to 1 default).

No backward-compat. The new quiet-hours gate is a hard short-circuit on Telegram send -- if the operator wants to disable it, they set FARMSURV_QUIET_HOURS_ENABLED=0. No 'if old behavior expected' branches.

Telegram-side logging: every quiet-hours suppress emits a log line of the form 'quiet-hours: alert_id=<uuid> camera=<name> suppressed=<TG#1|TG#2|TG#3> reason=is_night_at_edt_<true|false>_camera_in_set' so the operator can audit what got suppressed.
Tests for the OLD hardcoded-hour behavior are deleted, not skipped. If a test was asserting 'night starts at 8 PM', delete that assertion (it encoded the bug we are fixing).
Single commit per story on main with US-062x in the message. Squash-merge via forgejo per V2-046/V2-060 precedent.

stories.title: infra/alert_overrides_baseline.py: per-camera distant-vehicle baseline override with env-tunable keyword list
stories.scope: infra/alert_overrides_baseline.py (NEW, ~150 lines) + infra/__init__.py re-export + config/alert_overrides.json (NEW, ~30 lines, default config) + tests/test_alert_overrides_baseline.py (NEW, ~120 lines)
stories.rationale: Third layer of defense: vision LLM (Qwen3-VL-8B) sometimes writes 'faint', 'distant', 'light source', 'moving lights', 'reflection', 'glare', 'headlight' in its scene_description for what is actually a car driving at night with its headlights blooming. When this happens off-hours + camera in baseline set + L1 threat + vision sees vehicle + scene_description has distance keyword + no person present, demote L1 to L0 (no Telegram send). All knobs env-tunable: FARMSURV_BASELINE_OVERRIDE_ENABLED, FARMSURV_BASELINE_OVERRIDE_CAMERAS, FARMSURV_DISTANT_KEYWORDS.
acceptance: AC1: cd <INSTALL_DIR> && test -f infra/alert_overrides_baseline.py && wc -l infra/alert_overrides_baseline.py -> ~150 lines.

AC2: cd <INSTALL_DIR> && python3 -c 'from infra.alert_overrides_baseline import _apply_distant_vehicle_baseline_override; print(_apply_distant_vehicle_baseline_override)' -> exit 0 and prints the callable.
